basic_details.job_title: NFSU Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Visiting Medical Consultant/ Psychologist Counsellor Posts

qualification.education_qualification: MBBS from recognized University/equivalent recognized by MCI, Post Graduation and Graduation in Psychology
qualification.details: Medical Practitioner: MBBS degree from a recognized University or equivalent qualification, duly recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI). Minimum 02 years of professional experience in medical practice (no prior experience mandatory for MD/MS degree). Valid registration with MCI and Goa Medical Council. Retired Government/PSU doctors fulfilling criteria encouraged. Counsellor / Psychologist: Post Graduation and Graduation in Psychology from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum 02 years of professional experience in Counselling, including clinical experience in a Mental Health Centre and experience as a full-time Counsellor, preferably in an Educational/Counselling Centre.

selection_process: Scrutiny by duly constituted committee Interaction/Interview (if deemed necessary)
how_to_apply: Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-09-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NFSU to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: NFSU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NFSU Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NFSU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NFSU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Medical Practitioner and 1 for Counsellor / Psychologist.

content_sections.heading: NFSU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Medical Practitioner: MBBS degree from a recognized University or equivalent qualification, duly recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI). Minimum 02 years of professional experience in medical practice (no prior experience mandatory for MD/MS degree). Valid registration with MCI and Goa Medical Council. Retired Government/PSU doctors fulfilling criteria encouraged. Counsellor / Psychologist: Post Graduation and Graduation in Psychology from a recognized University/Institute. Minimum 02 years of professional experience in Counselling, including clinical experience in a Mental Health Centre and experience as a full-time Counsellor, preferably in an Educational/Counselling Centre.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 06-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NFSU to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the NFSU Visiting Medical Consultant / Psychologist-Counsellor posts is 06 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How can I apply for the NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: You can apply online through the official NFSU website or by using the direct application link provided in the Important Links section before the last date.

faq.question: Q3. What are the eligibility criteria for the Medical Practitioner post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MBBS degree from a recognized University, minimum 02 years of professional experience, and valid registration with MCI and Goa Medical Council.

faq.question: Q4. What are the eligibility criteria for the Counsellor / Psychologist post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduation and Graduation in Psychology from a recognized University/Institute with a minimum of 02 years of professional experience in Counselling.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for NFSU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves scrutiny by a duly constituted committee, followed by an interaction/interview if deemed necessary.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions are on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q8. Which city is the recruitment for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for NFSU's Goa campus, located in Ponda.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is available in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NFSU/Goa/EoI/Dr-Psych/2026.
